summary: MaintCourseDetailsASM is a user control for managing course details in HSPnet. It allows editing, viewing, and updating course parameters, including student PR selections, duplicate PR handling, withheld PR rankings, classmate stats visibility, destination configurations, and service code inclusions. The control dynamically configures available options based on course data (such as campus or section existence), provides service chooser UI elements, and enforces business logic through UI and code-behind event handlers.
purpose: To facilitate administrators in managing all details about a course, including permissions, statuses, PR options, and associated services for students, while ensuring business rules, conditions, and dependencies are handled consistently.

workflows.name: Update Course Details
steps: Screen renders components based on course (campus, section, services).
Administrator edits fields (checkboxes, dropdowns, listboxes) for course parameters.
Services chooser controls allow adding/removing service codes.
Upon save/update, fields are validated and saved with session context.
System applies business rules and redirects as necessary.

workflows.name: Service Code Configuration
steps: Service lists are populated based on available and allowed service codes.
Administrator can move service codes between included/excluded lists.
Service code changes are recorded in course details.

business_rules: If session is null, selection operations are canceled.
Course components (campus, section) are shown/hidden based on course data.
AllowAnySiteDestInService is enabled only if the relevant checkbox is checked.
Service codes selection must be tracked and submitted as a comma-separated list.
PRs allocated to campus and section fields must reflect course structure.
validations: Session must be valid for operations.
CourseID must be provided for course selection and updates.
Service lists, dropdowns, and checkboxes are validated before saving.
Selected service code IDs must be valid strings.
calculations: AllowedServiceCodeList is calculated from included service codes.
conditions: Show/hide campus or section rows based on CampusesExist and course structure.
Edit button is only visible if ScreenIsEditable.
Service chooser UI is enabled or disabled based on checkbox states.
system_behavior: Redirects to course details page after update.
Dynamically updates UI based on form data changes.
Show/hide services row when the relevant checkbox changes.
dependencies: UserSession needed for all data operations.
Dropdown and ListBox controls must map to course and service parameters.
ServiceCodes.ServiceCodeListAll and ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID functions fetch service data.
exceptions: If session is invalid, operations are canceled.
If course data is missing or invalid, UI components are hidden or not accessible.
content_gaps: Underlying data structure for Course and ServiceCode entities is not fully defined.
UI rendering logic relies on external resources and methods (e.g., Resources.NotApplicable, ServiceCodes.ServiceCodeListAll) not detailed in the content.
Exact validation rules for field values (e.g., allowed formats, limits) are not described.
